subject: Portal...
author: Xandu
body:
I had decided to buy this game, but a week ago I discovered that it is the same game that is in the orange box. Portal: Still Alive does include 14 new levels but I think that 1200 M$ points for 14 levels is a bit too much especially since I paided £40 for the original Portal in the Orange Box. There has been some talk that the new levels will be available for the Orange Box so I'm going to wait and see what happens.

-- The Creator --
